correctness.rationale: The coordinate and adjacent-Monge facets have projected normal norms sqrt((N-1)/N) and 2. Counter-paired interval transport proves the exact minimal-mass dual certificate; strict supermodular uncrossing and finite transport duality give attainment and strict positivity off support; elementary residue sums give T=(N²-p²-q²+g²)/12; common partition boundaries show the exact center dimension gcd(p,q)-1. The standard-library exact checker passed all 121 ordered pairs 2<=p,q<=12; an independent 1156-case integer sweep and six Chebyshev linear programs corroborated. Finite experiments are not used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: A complete intrinsic metric invariant and entire incenter-face dimension are determined for all rectangular Monge cost polytopes motivated by modern exact volume/Ehrhart research. The gcd condition produces a qualitative rigidity dichotomy (unique for coprime sizes; families otherwise), unseen in the square-only benchmark, and the explicit counter-transport and CRT proofs make the theorem broadly reproducible.
